result_text:
The average order value change is now empty (null) when the month has no orders, so that case no longer shows -100%. The full offline test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new case.

The change is in `YearOverYearSales.averageOrderValueChangePercent()` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java`. It returns null when `orderCount == 0`, which is how it already behaves when last year had no orders. I updated the Javadoc to say so. Revenue change and regions with orders in both years are untouched, so 20.00 to 40.00 still shows +100%.
